changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0012. Business profile is the contact and locale record for a business tenant. Tenant.Name remains the workspace name, so this table does not copy it. Index review: PK_BusinessProfiles on Id; UX_BusinessProfiles_TenantId is the one-profile lookup and enforces one active profile per tenant. Performance note: the unique index is filtered and matches the profile read by tenant.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE app.BusinessProfiles ( Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, TenantId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, LegalName NVARCHAR(200) NULL, Description NVARCHAR(1000) NULL, Email NVARCHAR(256) NULL, Phone NVARCHAR(32) NULL, Website NVARCHAR(500) NULL, Address NVARCHAR(300) NULL, City NVARCHAR(100) NULL, State NVARCHAR(100) NULL, Country NVARCHAR(100) NULL, PostalCode NVARCHAR(20) NULL, LogoUrl NVARCHAR(500) NULL, TimeZone NVARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, Currency NVARCHAR(3) NOT NULL, CreatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, UpdatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, DeletedAt DATETIME2 NULL, CreatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, UpdatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, RowVersion ROWVERSION NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_BusinessProfiles PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_BusinessProfiles_Tenants FOREIGN KEY (TenantId) REFERENCES app.Tenants (Id) ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_BusinessProfiles_TenantId ON app.BusinessProfiles (TenantId) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL;

changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0013. Branches belong to one business tenant. Branch code is unique inside the tenant, not globally. Index review: PK_Branches on Id; UX_Branches_TenantId_Code enforces the code rule for active rows and serves branch lookup; IX_Branches_TenantId supports the branch list. Status is not indexed alone because lists always start from TenantId. Performance note: both secondary indexes are filtered to active rows.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE app.Branches ( Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, TenantId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, Name NVARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, Code NVARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, Address NVARCHAR(300) NULL, City NVARCHAR(100) NULL, State NVARCHAR(100) NULL, Country NVARCHAR(100) NULL, PostalCode NVARCHAR(20) NULL, Phone NVARCHAR(32) NULL, Email NVARCHAR(256) NULL, TimeZone NVARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, Status NVARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, CreatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, UpdatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, DeletedAt DATETIME2 NULL, CreatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, UpdatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, RowVersion ROWVERSION NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_Branches PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_Branches_Tenants FOREIGN KEY (TenantId) REFERENCES app.Tenants (Id), CONSTRAINT CK_Branches_Status CHECK (Status IN (N'Active', N'Inactive')) ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_Branches_TenantId_Code ON app.Branches (TenantId, Code) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL; CREATE INDEX IX_Branches_TenantId ON app.Branches (TenantId, Name) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL;
